title: Phase 5 — Đa đội hình & nhánh Media
summary: Phase 5 plan: per-role engine routing (Claude, DeepSeek, Antigravity) with quota fallback, and a separate media/video rendering branch outside Git worktrees.
notes: Signals conflict. SPEC signals: teams.json config contract, engine env/command table, media_jobs SQLite data model. PRD-like signals: goals section (Mục tiêu), acceptance test table (Tiêu chí nghiệm thu), task checklist. No ADR signals (no Status field, no Context/Decision/Consequences structure). Ambiguity resolved by precedence rule (SPEC > PRD). Document is a phase plan with design; no taxonomy type fits it exactly, so user may wish to type-tag via manifest. cross_refs left empty: the mentions of .plan.md, .handover.md, .qa-report.md are artifact file types, not other planning docs; references to Phase 0 items S1, S5, S6, S7 and Phase 1/Phase 2 do not carry file paths. Output filename uses placeholder suffix NOHASH because the SHA-256 path hash could not be computed with the available tools (Read, Write, Grep, Glob); rename to {slug}-{first 8 hex of sha256 of source_path}.json before synthesis.
